ns2:section.sectionText: The purpose of this course is to develop professional competencies for Liberal Arts & Sciences students planning to be engaged in a professional experience (internship, service learning, part-time job, etc.) during the summer. The course is designed to prepare and support students during the professional experience. In the course, students will make connections between their academic goals, professional goals, and the professional experience. It is expected that students who join this course will have at least a 15 hours/week experience for 6 weeks over the summer. Interested students need to complete the form at https://forms.illinois.edu/sec/4335945 for enrollment consideration.
